other_conditions: Family annual income must not exceed ₹2,50,000 for studies within India or ₹5,00,000 for studies abroad
Only one member per family is eligible unless the family is BPL
Only members of Below Poverty Line (BPL) families are considered for study in Sikkim
Children of Government/Public Sector Undertaking employees are eligible
The institution of study must be recognized by the relevant authority in India
benefits_summary: Provides interest‑free loans up to ₹15 lakhs for professional courses, with a one‑year moratorium period.
